sources.entry: AutoBlogging Pro - AI-Powered Content Automation for WordPress Blogs #freemium

summary.name: AutoBlogging Pro
summary.one_liner: A hosted service that uses OpenAI models to generate SEO-optimized blog articles and auto-publish them to WordPress blogs via a plugin.
use_cases: Automatically generating and publishing niche blog posts
Producing SEO-structured articles for WordPress sites
Running news aggregation or content curation blogs
Creating product review articles at scale
summary.what_it_does: Autoblogging Pro lets you add a blog project with a domain, a short description, and keywords, then generates articles using a mix of OpenAI GPT 3, 3.5 and 4 models. You supply your own OpenAI API key. A WordPress plugin connects your site so generated articles, including featured images, can be fetched and posted automatically. The page lists keyword analysis, bulk generation, trending-topic articles, and article download in TXT or HTML format on paid plans. It states articles support 10+ languages and are designed with SEO structure, headlines and bullet points.
notable: Auto creation and publication of AI articles to WordPress via plugin
Uses user's own OpenAI API key
Free, Basic, Pro and Enterprise tiers with monthly article quotas
Supports multiple SEO plugins such as Yoast SEO and Rank Math
caveats: Requires a user-supplied OpenAI API key with credit
Free plan allows only 5 one-time articles and no WordPress plugin; paid plans listed at 135 and 290 articles per month
Sales are final and non-refundable, with no paid trial
